content.title: FDA Issues CRL to SNY's Regulatory Filing for Multiple Sclerosis Drug
content.summary: Sanofi receives an FDA CRL for tolebrutinib in nrSPMS after multiple review extensions. The EC clears Wayrilz for treating immune thrombocytopenia.

content.title: AGIO's Mitapivat Gets FDA Nod for Thalassemia Indication with REMS in Label
content.summary: Agios Pharmaceuticals wins FDA approval for Aqvesme in alpha- and beta-thalassemia, making mitapivat the only approved option, despite a new REMS.

content.title: Sanofi to Buy Dynavax for $2.2B to Boost Adult Vaccine Franchise
content.summary: SNY's $2.2 billion deal for Dynavax adds Heplisav-B, a shingles candidate, and other vaccine programs, strengthening its adult vaccine franchise and pipeline.

content.title: Why CorMedix Could be the Biopharma Name to Watch Early in 2026
content.summary: CorMedix is a promising biopharma firm in the catheter lock solution space. Continued success for its top products could fuel significant growth into 2026.

thumbnail.caption: CorMedix signage outside a biopharmaceutical laboratory, signifying the company's promising clinical-stage results.

content.title: GILD Exercises Option to License Assembly Bio's Herpes Programs
content.summary: Gilead exercises its option to license ASMB's HSV programs for developing long-acting candidates, ABI-1179 & ABI-5366, for recurrent genital herpes.

content.title: AZN, Daiichi's Enhertu Gets FDA Nod for First-Line Breast Cancer (Revised)
content.summary: AstraZeneca's Enhertu wins FDA nod as a first-line treatment for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.

content.title: MarketBeat’s Top 5 Rated Small-Cap Stocks
content.summary: Small-cap stocks are regaining momentum as rate cuts and the end of quantitative tightening drive a renewed risk-on environment.

content.title: BioMarin to Buy Rare Disease Drugmaker Amicus Therapeutics for $4.8B
content.summary: BMRN agrees to acquire FOLD for $4.8B, adding two growing rare disease drugs and a late-stage pipeline asset to its portfolio.

content.title: AZN, Daiichi's Enhertu Gets Breakthrough Tag for Expanded Cancer Use
content.summary: AstraZeneca's Enhertu wins FDA Breakthrough tag for expanded use in breast cancer, while a late-stage study on ceralasertib + Imfinzi in lung cancer misses its goal.
